title: Fix the Reversed Bubble Sort
description: The program should sort a list of numbers in ascending order using bubble sort. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print [1, 2, 5, 8, 9], sorted from smallest to largest.
actualProblem: The swap condition numbers[j] < numbers[j + 1] pushes larger values toward the front instead of the back, which sorts the list into descending order instead of ascending.
explanation: Bubble sort swaps adjacent out-of-order elements. To sort ascending, a swap should happen when the left element is greater than the right one (numbers[j] > numbers[j+1]) — the original code's < flips that logic.
